stat.tinkers_bauble.ring.description: The band of an Artificer's Ring. Grants attack damage and projectile power.
stat.tinkers_bauble.chain.description: The chain of an Artificer's Necklace. Grants armor and armor toughness.
stat.tinkers_bauble.gem.description: The gem set into jewelry. Provides no stats on its own.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.natural_repair.d: Each second, has a (5% x level) chance to restore 1% durability to your held tool or weapon and worn armor.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.natural_iron_arm: When your held tool, weapon or armor loses durability, it loses 1 extra durability to grant another piece (1 + level) barkskin.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.dense_blessing.d: Your held tool, weapon and worn armor lose 33% less durability.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.temperate_blessi: In extreme cold, gain +8 mining speed and +4 attack speed. In extreme heat, gain 16% resistance.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.enduring_blessin: Gain +6 mining speed and +2 armor toughness.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.plastify.descrip: Each level grants +5% melee damage, +0.25 projectile power and +1 armor toughness. Your held tool, weapon and armor have a 25% chance to not consume durability.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.not_hungry.descr: Restores 4 hunger and 4.8 saturation every minute.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.overcoat.descrip: Grants 50 overslime capacity to your held tool, weapon and worn armor, with a (5% x level) chance each second to grant 10 overslime. Works on non-slime gear as well, though overslime rejection still applies.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.overload.descrip: Each level grants 200 overslime capacity to your held tool, weapon and worn armor, and removes overslime rejection from non-slime gear.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.overforce.descri: Grants 1000 overslime capacity to your held tool, weapon and worn armor, with a (5% x level) chance each second to grant overslime equal to 0.25 x durability, and removes overslime rejection from non-slime gear.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.overregen.descri: Each second, has a (5% x level) chance to restore 25% overslime to your held tool, weapon and armor.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.overevolve.descr: While your held tool, weapon or armor has overslime, gain +20% mining speed, +15% attack speed, +0.06 draw speed and +0.06 projectile velocity, and take 5% less damage.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.precision.descri: Your held Tinkers' tool temporarily gains Silk Touch.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.brutal.descripti: Your attacks ignore the target's armor.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.strong_hand.desc: Increases the draw speed of your held Tinkers' bow.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.envenom.descript: Each attack has a 15% chance to poison the target for 5-10 seconds.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.bloodthirst.desc: Heals you for 5% of the damage dealt on each attack.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.life_steal.descr: Heals for 50% of the damage dealt on each attack.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.deposition_effec: Below Y=72, each level reduces durability loss of held tools, weapons and worn armor by 0.417% per block, up to 80%.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.rejuvenate.descr: Restores 10% of missing health every minute.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.brittle_durabili: When gear takes durability damage, there is a (1-70%^level) chance to lose 1 less durability and a (1-95%^level) chance to lose 1 more.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.overcapacitor.de: Held tools, weapons and worn armor gain 100 overslime capacity and FE storage equal to 100x their capacity; each second per level converts 200 FE into 1 overslime. Works on non-slime items.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.overgrind.descri: Held tools, weapons and worn armor gain 100 overslime capacity and lose overslime rejection; each second has a 15% chance to restore 1 durability, with a 33% chance to consume 1 overslime when it does. Works on non-slime items.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.frost.descriptio: Each attack freezes the target for 5 seconds.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.gem_resistance.d: Each second, has a 5% chance to gain Resistance for 5 seconds.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.ice_armor.descri: Each time you take damage, has a 5% chance to take no damage.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.fortune.descript: The wearer gains Fortune equal to the trait level when breaking blocks.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.flawless.descrip: Grants an ability slot, 4 armor and 2 armor toughness.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.flight.descripti: Recharges on the ground to provide up to 30 seconds of creative flight.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.radiation.descri: Each attack has a 50% chance to wither the target for 5-10 seconds.
modifier.tinkers_bauble.flame.descriptio: Ignites the target for 5 seconds on each attack.
